**📐 Maintainability & Code Quality** | **🟡 Minor** | **⚡ Quick win**

**Log the reason before the final gate refuses an extraction failure.**

If `_extract_pr_work_issue` fails, this branch returns 1 without writing a final-gate log line. The ambiguous case does log inside the extractor. Body-metadata failure and invalid-slug failure do not log anything. Every other refusal in this function writes a `DEFENSE-IN-DEPTH`/`failing closed` entry. Add a matching log line so operators can diagnose refused merges.

<details>
<summary>Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
-		linked=$(_extract_pr_work_issue "$pr_number" "$repo_slug" explicit) || return 1
+		if ! linked=$(_extract_pr_work_issue "$pr_number" "$repo_slug" explicit); then
+			echo "[pulse-merge] _pulse_merge_admin_safety_check: explicit worker issue association failed for PR #${pr_number} in ${repo_slug} — failing closed" >>"$LOGFILE"
+			return 1
+		fi
```
</details>
